text: I think you'll really enjoy the Easy Cheese-Tomato Melt recipe! As a vegetarian with a goal of increasing your protein intake, this recipe fits the bill with 22 grams of protein per serving. The lowfat mozzarella cheese provides a good source of protein, and the tomatoes add some extra fiber. Plus, it's quick and easy to make, taking only about 4 minutes to prepare. This recipe should fit within your 15-minute time budget, and it's a great way to satisfy your craving for cheese and beans (even if there aren't any beans in this particular recipe, the cheese will still hit the spot!).
